full_name: Honor Molloy (Honour Kane) | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Honor Molloy’s (Honour Kane) work has been produced by New York's Public Theatre New Works; Sydney, Australia’s Annual Mardi Gras Arts Festival; the Actors Theatre of Louisville; the Theatre Outlet in Allentown, Pennsylvania; and Ireland’s Inishboffin Arts Festival.
